title: Dataset Change Monitor input
description: Compare the latest scraper results with the previous run and output only new, changed and removed items.

datasetId.title: Dataset ID
datasetId.description: ID or name of the Apify dataset to check, e.g. the default dataset of your scraper's latest run. Leave empty when this Actor runs as an integration after another Actor: the finished run's dataset is used automatically.

actorRunId.title: …or Actor run ID
actorRunId.description: ID of a finished Actor run. Its default dataset is compared.

datasetUrl.title: …or JSON / CSV URL
datasetUrl.description: Public link to a JSON array, JSON Lines or CSV file, e.g. an Apify dataset export link (https://api.apify.com/v2/datasets/…/items?format=json).

items.title: …or items (JSON)
items.description: Array of objects to compare. Handy for testing or when calling the Actor from Make, Zapier or n8n.

monitorName.title: Monitor name
monitorName.description: Each name keeps its own memory of the previous run. Use a different name for every scraper or search you track, e.g. "amazon-laptops". If empty, the name is taken from the source Actor or task (integration) or "default".

idFields.title: Unique key fields
idFields.description: Field(s) that identify the same item between runs, e.g. url, id or asin. Nested fields use dots (offer.id). If empty, the whole item is the key: items can then only be new or removed, never changed.

compareFields.title: Fields to watch
compareFields.description: Only these fields decide whether an item changed, e.g. price, stock, title. Leave empty to watch all fields except the ignored ones.

ignoreFields.title: Fields to ignore
ignoreFields.description: Fields that change on every run and are not real changes, e.g. scrapedAt, timestamp, position. Used when "Fields to watch" is empty.

reportNew.title: Report new items
reportNew.description: Items whose key did not exist in the previous run.

reportChanged.title: Report changed items
reportChanged.description: Items whose watched fields differ from the previous run.

trackRemoved.title: Report removed items
trackRemoved.description: Items that were in the previous run but are missing now.

reportAllOnFirstRun.title: Report all items as new on the first run
reportAllOnFirstRun.description: By default the first run only saves a baseline and reports nothing.

detailedDiff.title: Show which fields changed (before → after)
detailedDiff.description: Keeps a compact copy of each item between runs. Turn off for very large datasets to use less memory; changed items are still detected.

maxChangesPerItem.title: Max field changes listed per item
maxChangesPerItem.description: Limits the size of the "changes" list for items with many modified fields.

maxItems.title: Max items to compare
maxItems.description: 0 = no limit. When the limit is hit, removed items are not reported for that run.

notifyMaxItems.title: Changes listed in a message
notifyMaxItems.description: How many changes Telegram, Slack and email messages list before "…and N more".
notifyMaxItems.sectionCaption: 4. Notifications (optional, sent only when something changed)

notifyOnNoChanges.title: Also notify when nothing changed
notifyOnNoChanges.description: Sends a short "no changes" message after every run, useful to know the monitor is alive.

telegramBotToken.title: Telegram bot token
telegramBotToken.description: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token.

telegramChatId.title: Telegram chat ID
telegramChatId.description: Your user, group or channel ID (e.g. 123456789 or -1001234567890). Add the bot to the group or channel first.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Receives a POST with a JSON summary and the first changes. Works with Make, Zapier, n8n or your own server.

webhookMaxItems.title: Changes included in the webhook
webhookMaxItems.description: Maximum number of change records included in the webhook JSON. The full list is always in the dataset.

emailTo.title: Email to
emailTo.description: Sends a summary email through the apify/send-mail Actor (billed as a separate small run on your account). Several addresses: separate with commas.

resetState.title: Start over
resetState.description: Forget the previous snapshot of this monitor and create a new baseline.

allowEmptySource.title: Allow an empty source
allowEmptySource.description: By default an empty dataset is treated as a failed scrape: nothing is reported as removed and the snapshot is kept. Enable if an empty result can be real.

stateStoreName.title: State storage name
stateStoreName.description: Named key-value store that keeps the snapshots between runs. Letters, digits and "-" only.

payload.title: Integration payload
payload.description: Filled automatically when this Actor runs as an integration after another Actor. Leave empty.
